seoTitle: Bob's Burgers Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Bob's Burgers test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Bob, Linda, Tina, Gene, Louise, Teddy, Mr. Fischoeder or Gayle — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the long-suffering burger artist, the kid in the bunny-ear hat, or the regular who never leaves? Answer 11 everyday questions about family, work and bad ideas, and find out which Bob's Burgers character you are.

characters.name: Bob Belcher
characters.title: The Burger Artist
characters.summary: Talented, dry and long-suffering. You're brilliant at what you do, even if the business side gives you a headache.
description: Like Bob, you're brilliant at your craft. He's a third-generation restaurant owner with excellent cooking skills.
Money isn't your strong point. Bob has weak business sense.
You're an artist, in your own way. Mr. Fischoeder calls Bob a "beef artist."
characters.flaw: You sigh more than you smile, even when things are fine.
characters.signature: A spatula, a long sigh and a burger nobody else would think of.
characters.clashReason: they'd sigh at you, very, very deeply

characters.name: Linda Belcher
characters.title: The Cheerleader
characters.summary: Upbeat, loyal and always ready to sing. You bring the fun, and you'd do anything for your family.
description: Like Linda, you're upbeat and full of energy. She's a loyal, devoted wife, and she's always singing.
You've got a big personality. Linda calls herself a "pre-middle-aged mother."
You're everyone's biggest fan. Linda supports her family through every crazy plan.
characters.flaw: You get so excited that you forget to think things through.
characters.signature: A big laugh, a made-up song and a whole lot of enthusiasm.
characters.clashReason: they'd burst into song in the middle of your serious conversation

characters.name: Tina Belcher
characters.title: The Dreamer
characters.summary: Quiet, awkward and full of imagination. You think more than you say, and you often turn out to be the sensible one.
description: Like Tina, you're soft-spoken and a bit reserved. She's the eldest Belcher kid.
You're more sensible than you look. Tina often acts as the voice of reason.
You've got a big crush. Tina's on-again, off-again love interest is Jimmy Jr.
characters.flaw: You overthink everything, and then say it out loud, slowly.
characters.signature: A long groan, a vivid imagination and a crush you can't stop thinking about.
characters.clashReason: they'd make it very awkward, very slowly

characters.name: Gene Belcher
characters.title: The Performer
characters.summary: Upbeat, enthusiastic and very loud. You love music, you love attention, and you're easily distracted by both.
description: Like Gene, you're upbeat and enthusiastic. He's the middle Belcher kid, and an aspiring musician.
You're not afraid to look silly. Gene often promotes the restaurant in a burger costume.
You lose focus easily. The Belchers call it "Gene-ing out."
characters.flaw: You get distracted halfway through almost everything.
characters.signature: A keyboard, a costume and a song nobody asked for.
characters.clashReason: they'd drown out your conversation with a song

characters.name: Louise Belcher
characters.title: The Schemer
characters.summary: Bold, clever and slightly terrifying. You've always got a scheme on the go, and you're not afraid to get your way.
description: Like Louise, you've got a dark sense of humour. She's the youngest Belcher kid, and she's a born schemer.
You know how to get in anywhere. Louise picks locks as a hobby.
You've got a signature look. Louise never takes off her pink bunny-ear hat.
characters.flaw: You'll manipulate anyone to get what you want.
characters.signature: A bunny-ear hat, an evil grin and a plan already in motion.
characters.clashReason: they'd scheme against you, and enjoy every minute

characters.name: Teddy
characters.title: The Regular
characters.summary: Kind-hearted, chatty and always willing to help. You're the most loyal friend anyone could ask for, even if you overshare a bit.
description: Like Teddy, you're kind-hearted and talkative. He's a handyman, and the Belchers' most loyal regular customer.
You've seen a bit of the world. Teddy is a former Navy serviceman.
You're a little bit awkward, and that's okay. Teddy is socially awkward, but always means well.
characters.flaw: You overshare, and you get attached very quickly.
characters.signature: A toolbox, a long story and a seat at the counter.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you every detail of their week, twice

characters.name: Mr. Fischoeder
characters.title: The Eccentric
characters.summary: Rich, theatrical and completely unpredictable. You do whatever you like, and you make it look effortless.
description: Like Mr. Fischoeder, you're one of a kind. He's an eccentric landlord who owns much of the town.
You dress to impress. Mr. Fischoeder wears a white suit, a cape and an eyepatch.
You've got a bit of a villain about you. Louise says he's "one white cat away from being a supervillain."
characters.flaw: You do things just for fun, even when other people pay the price.
characters.signature: A white suit, a dramatic entrance and a whim you'll follow anywhere.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a dramatic decision about your life, just for fun

characters.name: Gayle
characters.title: The Drama Queen
characters.summary: Creative, dramatic and full of feelings. You live for your art and your cats, and you're never short of a reason to make a scene.
description: Like Gayle, you're an artist. She's Linda's sister, and a neurotic artist.
You love cats. Gayle is a big cat lover.
You know how to get attention. Gayle often fakes injuries.
characters.flaw: You turn every small problem into a big drama.
characters.signature: A paintbrush, a cat on your lap and a dramatic sigh.
characters.clashReason: they'd make your big day all about them

options.text: Sigh, and quietly die inside
Laugh it off, and offer them seconds anyway
Start planning your revenge
Ask if you can have their leftovers

questions.text: A free afternoon, all to yourself. You spend it...

options.text: Writing stories in your journal
Painting, with a very dramatic soundtrack
Chatting with anyone who'll listen, for hours
Making music as loudly as possible

questions.text: You come up with a plan to make some fast money. You...

options.text: Scheme it all out. It's foolproof. Probably
Spend it before you've even made it
Worry it'll go wrong, then do it anyway
Get way too excited, and tell everyone

questions.text: Your crush walks into the room. You...

options.text: Freeze, and make a long, awkward noise
Serenade them
Fake a small injury, so they'll come over
Pretend you don't care at all

questions.text: A friend needs help with a DIY job. You...

options.text: Show up with your toolbox before they've finished asking
Help, grumbling the whole time
Send someone else to do it
Help, quietly and very carefully

questions.text: Your family throws you a surprise party. You...

options.text: Scream, sing and dance on the table
Act annoyed, but secretly love it
Cry, and make a very long speech
Get emotional. You didn't think anyone remembered

questions.text: You're at a very fancy dinner party. You...

options.text: Make a grand entrance, and tell outrageous stories
Sneak off to see what you can find
Stand in the corner, overthinking everything
Talk to absolutely everyone, and love every minute

questions.text: You're asked to give a speech. You...

options.text: Grab the microphone, and refuse to give it back
Speak slowly, in a monotone, and leave nothing out
Ramble about your feelings for twenty minutes
Be dramatic, mysterious and slightly threatening

questions.text: Business is slow at work. You...

options.text: Invent something brand new, and hope for the best
Put on a costume, and dance outside
Sabotage the competition
Ask if you can have the day off

questions.text: You run a struggling family restaurant, and the landlord wants the rent. You...

options.text: Beg for more time, and mean every word
Cheer everyone up, and promise it'll all work out
Find some leverage on the landlord
Offer to fix things in his buildings for free

questions.text: You own most of the town, and you're bored. You...

options.text: Throw a wild party, just because you can
Commission a giant portrait of your cat
Build a giant arcade, and live in it
Give everyone in town a free lunch
